A few useful details

Before choosing a package.

What does “from” mean?

It is the starting price for the limited scope shown. Product complexity, integrations, content migration, or extra workflows can change the quote. You receive a written scope and total before committing.

What counts as a revision round?

One consolidated list of feedback on the current draft. Two rounds cover adjustments within the agreed scope. New pages, new features, or a different direction are discussed and quoted before extra work begins.

Can I start simple and add booking or sales later?

Yes, where the chosen platform supports it. We can plan for a later phase, but additional features are a separate project. Some upgrades may require a platform change or migration.

Can you improve my existing website?

We review the current platform and condition first, then quote the work. A refresh is not automatically priced as a new One Page site.

When do I pay, and when will it launch?

The proposed schedule is 50% to begin and 50% before launch for standard packages, confirmed in your agreement. Custom work may use milestones. Timing depends on scope and receipt of content and feedback. No payment is collected from this preview.
